Israeli blockade prevents access to vital care for Gaza's amputees
item.description:
Israeli blockade prevents access to vital care for Gaza's amputees

"My life is worse than before the war," Omar Halawa, a Palestinian child amputee from Gaza told Middle East Eye.

"Everything I used to do, I can't do anymore," the young boy said, who was injured after an Israeli tank shelled him and his cousins while they were fetching water for their family.

His cousins were killed, but he survived. 

Omar, like thousands of other Palestinian amputees, is waiting to receive rehabilitation treatment and a prosthetic limb, which may not come due to Israel's blockade on Gaza.

Israeli authorities have prevented prosthetics and materials from entering the besieged enclave, which has compounded the existing crisis caused by the destruction of hospitals during its genocidal war, preventing Palestinians from accessing critical healthcare services.

Iran's Araghchi says US-Iran negotiations are not over
item.description:
Iran's Araghchi says US-Iran negotiations are not over

At a diplomatic summit in Baghdad on Sunday, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says Tehran’s offer to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within six days remains on the table, with US-Iran talks set to resume on the seventh day if Washington accepts its conditions. 

The proposal comes amid escalating attacks around the strategic waterway and mounting tensions over US sanctions and a blockade of Iranian ports.

item.title: Warning issued in Saudi's Jazan
item.description:
Warning issued in Saudi's Jazan

Saudi Arabia's civil defence issued a warning alert early on Monday over the city of Jazan, which has since passed. 

"The danger has passed in Jizan City. For your safety, continue following #CivilDefense instructions and avoid gathering and filming," the General Directorate of Saudi Civil Defense said in a post on X.

item.title: Austrian Airlines flight from Tel Aviv diverts to Bulgaria's Sofia after 'threat'
item.description:
Austrian Airlines flight from Tel Aviv diverts to Bulgaria's Sofia after 'threat'

An  Austrian Airlines flight from Tel Aviv made an emergency landing in Bulgarian capital Sofia after a threat was made against the aircraft, according to Reuters citing an airline spokesperson.

The plane, carrying 57 people, was heading from Tel Aviv to Vienna. It landed safely at 6.42 pm GMT on Sunday.

The airline indicated that Airbus A320 AIR.PA is being searched, and passengers will be rebooked onto an alternative flight once that is complete.

Earlier, Sky News reported based on a statement from Bulgaria’s transport ministry that the plane landed after a "bomb threat signal"

"During the flight, on the border with Romania, the crew reported a bomb threat signal and decided to land in Sofia extraordinarily," the ministry said.

Palestinian girl killed by Israeli army fire in central Gaza
item.description: A Palestinian girl was killed by Israeli army fire in the central Gaza Strip on Sunday, the official Palestinian news agency WAFA reported, Anadolu reports. Medical sources said Misk Hazem al-Dalou died from wounds sustained when Israeli forces opened fire toward tents housing displaced Palestinians in the Maghazi refugee camp. Separately, Israeli military vehicles opened heavy fire toward tents sheltering displaced Palestinians in the al-Mawasi area of Rafah in southern Gaza. Israeli artillery also shelled areas northeast of Khan Younis. The attacks came despite a ceasefire in effect in Gaza since Oct. 10, 2025, amid continued Israeli violations of the agreement. item.title: EU condemns Israeli occupier attacks on Palestinians, European diplomats in occupied West Bank
item.description: The EU on Sunday strongly condemned recent attacks by violent Israeli occupiers in the occupied West Bank, including attacks targeting European diplomats, Anadolu reports. In a statement, the EU’s diplomatic service acknowledged condemnations by several Israeli representatives but called for accountability and concrete measures to prevent further violence. “The EU strongly condemns the latest attacks by violent settlers in the West Bank, including on European diplomats,” the statement said. item.title: California governor says US military aid to Israel must be conditioned
